name: L-Tracing
aliases: Light Visibility Estimation on Neural Surfaces by Sphere Tracing
definition: A method for fast light visibility estimation on neural surfaces that respects solid object surface and binary geometry occlusions, producing sharper shadows and speculars compared to volumetric integration.
summary: L-Tracing estimates light visibility on neural surfaces using binary sphere tracing, producing sharper shadows and faster computation than volumetric integration.
